bestFor: CRM-style record pages, forms, list views, data tables and page headers
multi-tenant products that must be re-themed by customers via CSS custom properties
apps that need a first-class compact/comfy density switch
teams that want contrast guaranteed by token pairing (on-surface with surface, on-accent with accent-container)
avoidFor: marketing or editorial sites (13px base text, system font, no display type voice)
brand-distinctive consumer products (look is purposely Salesforce)
anything needing a published public, open-source repo: licence and repo access are restrictive
sub-16px-radius brutalist or strongly geometric aesthetics (Cosmos is pill-and-20px-round)

families: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif, emoji faces (--slds-g-font-family-base)
typography.notes: Cosmos values (Lightning Blue differs: scale-3..8 = 18, 20, 24, 28, 32, 42px). Line heights shown are base 1.5 x size; unitless tokens: line-height-1..6 = 1, 1.25, 1.375, 1.5, 1.75, 2, base 1.5. Weights are tokens 100..700 plus bold; table headers use 600, alerts 600, container headings 400. Body base is 13px, a deliberately small enterprise size; inputs and buttons render at 14-16px. font-scale-ratio token = 1.15 but the published steps are hand-rounded rem values, not a pure 1.15 series. No letter-spacing tokens (0 = none specified). Compact density collapses the type scale: font-scale-var-2 16->14px, var-3 20->16, var-4 24->20; var-5 and up unchanged. Measure tokens: sizing-content-1..3 = 20/45/60ch; sizing-heading-1..3 = 20/25/35ch. Rule from guidance: lowest step number = smallest.

50.note: pivot step, identical in both modes
pivot step, identical in both modes

accents.otherPalettes: cloud-blue, electric-blue, green, hot-orange, indigo, orange, pink, purple, red, teal, violet, yellow: each 14 steps 10,15,20,30,40,50,60,65,70,80,90,95 plus neutral 0..100

semantic.containers: {error|warning|success|info}-container-1 = light-dark(step 90, step 30), paired with on-{state}-1 = light-dark(step 40, step 90)

color.darkMode: Cosmos only (Lightning Blue is light-only: 0 light-dark() calls, static #fff/#f3f3f3/#e5e5e5 surfaces and on-surface #757575/#2e2e2e/#181818). Native CSS: every token is light-dark(lightValue, darkValue) driven by color-scheme; dark values are produced by MIRRORING the lightness ladder (palette step N dark = step (100-N) light, e.g. neutral-10 #181818 <-> neutral-90 #e5e5e5; blue-40 <-> blue-60), with step 50 as the fixed pivot that is identical in both modes (flagged 'static'). Components therefore reference semantic tokens and never branch. Surface-1 #fff -> #242424, not black; shadows double opacity in dark (e.g. #0000002e -> #0000005c); backdrop is color-mix(in oklab, neutral-20/95, transparent 20%). A 'Theme' is a class (.slds-theme_cosmos / lightning-blue) on :root; the source palette is authored in OKLCH and converted to hex at build.
color.contrastNotes: Computed 2026-10-08: on-surface-1 #5c5c5c on white 6.69:1; neutral-50 #757575 4.61:1 (lowest step that passes small text, hence the pivot); border-1 #c9c9c9 only 1.66:1 (decorative dividers) while border-2 #5c5c5c is 6.69:1 (controls): the system forces the choice by role; white on Cosmos accent-container brand-50 #066afe 4.67:1; white on Lightning Blue #0176d3 4.63:1; accent-2 #0250d9 on white 6.66:1; Cosmos error text #b60554 6.69:1; dark on-surface-1 #aeaeae on #242424 7.0:1; dark border-2 #757575 on #242424 3.37:1. Rules in the docs: always pair on-surface with surface, on-accent with accent-container, on-{state} with {state}-container; border-2 for interactive, border-1 for presentational; the *-base-NN tokens carry comments such as 'if used as a background use Base 100-65 to meet accessibility', i.e. permitted foreground steps are listed per background step. WCAG 2.1 AA is the stated target.

spacing.base: 4px rem steps (0.25rem), 12-step scale; values in rem so they follow user font size
spacing.sizing: separate sizing scale spacing != sizing: 2,4,8,12,16,20,24,28,32,48,64,80,160,240,320,480 (sizing-1..16) plus border widths 1,2,3,4 and ch measures

radius.rule: Cosmos: radius-border-1..4 = 4, 8, 12, 20px, pill 15rem, circle 100%. Buttons use pill; containers (cards, modals) use radius-4 = 20px (container-radius-border), inputs radius-2 = 8px, badges radius-1. Lightning Blue: 2, 4, 8, 16px; buttons/inputs use radius-2 = 4px. Radius is a theme-level decision exposed only through four steps plus pill/circle; components pick a step, never a pixel value.

shadows: shadow-block-start-N / block-end / inline-start / inline-end variants (flip for docked panels, RTL-safe)
focus: shadow-outset-focus-1 = 0 0 0 2px neutral-100(surface) + 0 0 0 4px brand-base-15 (dark navy #001e5b in light)
depth.borders: Cosmos containers: border-width 0, border colour transparent, container shadow none (s-container-*): cards separate from the page by surface lightness only (card hook default falls back to shadow-2 only when the shared hook is unset) (container-1 #fff on surface-2 #f3f3f3). Lightning Blue containers: border-1 colour (#c9c9c9-class) plus shadow-2 and 4px radius. Footer rule 1px. Input border 1px solid border-2 with inset 3-layer shadow on focus; invalid inputs use error-container fill. Selected table row = brand-base-90 fill + 2px inset focus shadow.
depth.blur: Only the modal backdrop: color-mix(in oklab, palette neutral-20 (light) / neutral-95 (dark), transparent 20%), no backdrop-filter specified.

easings: ease-in-out (150ms transform + box-shadow on brand buttons)
motion.notes: Named duration tokens: instantly 0, immediately 0.05s (3 frames), quickly 0.1s (6 frames), promptly 0.2s (12 frames), slowly 0.4s (24 frames), paused 3.2s, toast-short 4.8s, toast-medium 9.6s. Tokens are annotated in frames at 60fps. No easing tokens exist: easings are hard-coded in component CSS, so motion is the least systematised layer. Cosmos brand buttons lift on hover: transform translateY(-2px) with a 0 2px 0 solid brand-20 shadow; bordered buttons lift 1.5px; active state is a triple inset shadow (pressed-in).

controlHeightsPx.small button (line-height sizing-8 28px,: as authored in CSS; ambiguous, unknown which dominates
controlHeightsPx.density mechanism: --slds-g-spacing-var-N, -var-block-N, -var-inline-N and --slds-g-font-scale-var-N tokens whose value switches between comfy and compact; comfy spacing-var 1..12 = 4,8,12,16,24,32,40,48,56,64,72,80px; compact = 2,2,4,8,12,16,24,32,40,48,56,64px; block compact = 2,4,8,8,12,16,24,32,...; inline compact = 2,4,8,12,12,16,24,...

components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Component CSS exposes the most state hooks of the four systems: e.g. button has per-variant (brand, neutral, destructive, success, inverse, outline-brand, stateful) hooks for color-background, -hover, -active, color-border, -hover, -active, text-color, -hover, -active, shadow, shadow-focus, shadow-hover, radius, spacing inline/block; 275 distinct --slds-c-* component hooks and 113 --slds-s-* shared hooks are referenced by the stylesheet, resolved through a fallback chain var(--slds-c-X, var(--slds-s-Y, var(--slds-g-Z))). Variants: sizes (small/default/large via utility classes), states hover, focus(-visible), active, disabled, selected, invalid, plus 'stateful' toggles. Sizes are not expressed as a systematic XS-XL ladder. Count is the number of component folders in design-system-2/dist/components.

tokenArchitecture: Four scopes expressed in the custom-property name: --slds-r-* reference (raw theme palettes, e.g. --slds-r-color-brand-50), --slds-g-* GLOBAL (the public styling hooks: surface, on-surface, border, accent, accent-container, feedback, palette, spacing, sizing, font, radius, shadow, duration, density 'var' variants), --slds-s-* SHARED (cross-component roles: button, input, container, table, link, navigation, pageheader, label), --slds-c-* COMPONENT (per-component overrides). Every component declaration is the cascade var(--slds-c-comp-prop, var(--slds-s-role-prop, var(--slds-g-token))), so a brand can override at any scope. Source is W3C DTCG JSON built by Style Dictionary with transforms name/kebab, light-dark-css-var, oklch-to-hex; outputs CSS, JSON, Android Kotlin and iOS Swift. Themes (Cosmos, Lightning Blue) are classes on :root with identical token names (theme parity is validated; values differ, and only Cosmos has dark values). Officially only global hooks are a supported consumer API ('do not reassign globals'); shared/component hooks are described as unsupported in SLDS 2 by Salesforce developer docs (secondary source, not verified on the JS-rendered docs site) even though the shipped CSS still reads them.
distinctiveness: Semantic colour roles that always come in pairs (surface / on-surface, accent-container / on-accent, error-container / on-error) with a numeric rank 1..3; navy-tinted titles (on-surface-3 #03234d) rather than black; Cosmos pill buttons that physically lift (translateY(-2px) + hard 2px under-shadow), 20px container radius and flat, shadowless, borderless cards separated by surface tone; a pink/magenta error and teal success in Cosmos; comfy/compact density as first-class tokens; default hue is a vivid electric blue (#066afe).
weaknesses: 13px base size and system-ui stack give no typographic personality
documentation site is JS-rendered and partly gated; the open source repo is private and the licence is custom
scope story is confusing: shipped CSS reads --slds-c and --slds-s hooks while docs say only --slds-g is supported
no easing tokens, no component-size ladder, density only through a few spacing/font vars
Cosmos feedback colours (pink error, teal success) break conventional red/green semantics and rely on icons/text
line-height for sizes is a single multiplier, not per-size optical values
takeaways: Pairing contract: every background role has a named foreground role (surface/on-surface, accent-container/on-accent); contrast is guaranteed by the pairing, so designers never pick text colours freehand
Mirror the lightness ladder for dark mode with a fixed pivot step that stays identical, and use CSS light-dark() so components never branch
Document the permitted foreground steps per background step in the token description (e.g. 'if used as background use Base 100-65')
Resolve every property through a three-tier var() fallback chain (component > shared > global) so brands override at the right altitude
Express density as paired comfy/compact token values (spacing-var, font-scale-var) switched in one place
Decorative border-1 vs interactive border-2: two border colours chosen by role, not by taste
Annotate duration tokens in frames (50ms = 3 frames) and keep a short named set (immediately, quickly, promptly, slowly)
Theme = class on :root with identical token names; validate parity between themes automatically
